bull.t: Strong Revenue Growth And Operating Improvement
bull.b: Revenue growth is translating into early operating improvement: Q3 sales rose 77% and adjusted EBITDA turned positive, while gross margin reached 47.5%. If sustained, this operating leverage can support a more durable path toward profitability as the platform scales.

Full agency renewal and substantial contracted or retainer-based revenue improve visibility beyond one-off campaigns. Recurring relationships can stabilize the revenue base, support planning and utilization, and reduce dependence on continuously replacing customers.

The combination of FanEngine’s IP monetization model and Hatchet’s proprietary creator data broadens GameSquare beyond campaign services. These assets could support higher-margin offerings, differentiated insights and deeper engagement with gaming audiences over time.

bear.b: Gross-margin improvement has not yet overcome the company’s very large operating and net losses. Continued losses weaken retained capital and show that revenue growth has not yet produced sustainable profitability, leaving execution of the cost structure and scaling plan critical.

Ongoing operating and free-cash-flow deficits mean the business is consuming rather than internally generating cash. Until profitability and working-capital performance improve, funding growth and meeting obligations may depend on outside capital or asset monetization.

bear.t: Rising Leverage And Weaker Equity Cushion
bear.b: The sharp increase in debt relative to equity leaves less balance-sheet flexibility while profitability remains deeply negative. Higher leverage can amplify financial pressure, constrain capital allocation and make the company more sensitive to setbacks in its operating improvement plan.
